column1: # Traduzione inglese dei testi del corso Tongji (domande, lezioni 13-25).

column2: You want to know what time the library closes. What do you ask?
The time goes before the verb: 几点 + 关门.
和 links nouns and pronouns, not sentences.
The courier says 「对方付款」. What does it mean?
You pay 20 yuan for a parcel that costs 15. The courier says:
不过 and 可是 = but, however.
You are asked 「你常常在网上买东西吗？」 and you often do. What do you answer?
You are asked 「今天天气怎么样？」 and it’s a lovely day. What do you answer?
Which answer gives the lowest judgement?
How do you address Mrs Wang, a friend of your mother’s?
I’m listening to you because you are ill.
Tell me if you are ill.
Which season comes after 夏天?
You want your aunt to tell your mother not to worry. Which sentence do you use?
请告诉 + person; 让 + person + verb.
You are asked 「你习惯这儿的生活吗？」 and by now you’re used to it. What do you answer?
What is the difference between 「一月」 and 「一个月」?
The name of a month has no measure word.
一月 = January; 一个月 = one month
一月 = one month; 一个月 = January
一月 = Monday; 一个月 = one month
You have never been to Beijing. How do you say it?
You are asked 「寒假有多长时间？」. Which answer is suitable?
You answer with a length of time.
How do you say “the second time”?
只 = only; 门 = measure word for school subjects.
I have three classes a day.
How do you correctly say “I studied Chinese for six months”?
The duration goes after the verb.
You are asked 「你看过这个电影吗？」 and you have seen it. What do you answer?
You ask the way to the bookshop. Which sentence do you use?
At the hospital you want to speak to the doctor. What do you call him?
Someone thanks you: 「太谢谢你了！」. What do you answer?
You are asked 「远不远？」 and the place is two minutes away. What do you answer?
往 = towards; 拐 = to turn.
The passer-by says 「我不清楚。」. What does he mean?
In China, what does 「一层」 mean in a building?
In China the ground floor is the first floor (一层).
The first floor above the ground floor
The waiter greets you: 「欢迎光临！几位？」. There are three of you. What do you answer?
With 比 you don’t use 很 / 非常.
You’ve finished eating and want to pay. What do you say?
结账 = to pay the bill.
Your friend is worried the dish is spicy. You reassure him:
V + 不 + result = not to manage.
I can’t really describe this flavour.
I didn’t say anything about the flavour.
The flavour isn’t clear to see.
You are asked 「你吃饱了吗？」 and you’ve eaten enough. What do you answer?
Sweet and sour (both sour and sweet)
Someone offers to tutor you for free, but you want to pay. How do you refuse?
那不行 = out of the question.
You want to say “Let’s do this: we’ll meet on Saturday.” How do you say it?
With an object the verb is repeated: V + O + V + 得 + adjective.
You are asked 「他辅导得怎么样？」 and you think he’s good. What do you answer?
What is the difference between 地 and 得?
地 goes before the verb (manner), 得 after the verb (degree)
地 goes after the verb, 得 before it
You’re invited to a party and want to assure them you’ll be there. What do you say?
一定 goes before the verb.
A friend apologises: 「对不起，我来晚了。」. What do you answer?
A guest is leaving. What do you say at the door?
You are asked 「你复习了吗？」 and you haven’t. The correct short answer:
On its own you use 没有, not 没.
The doctor tells you 「多喝水」. What is he advising?
多 + verb = to do more of it.
A friend suggests a walk, but you’re expecting a visitor. What do you say?
You are asked 「你的爱好是什么？」. Which answer is suitable?
A friend lists: 「看书啦、听音乐啦……」. What is 啦 for?
更 goes right before the adjective.
「他们的汉语水平差不多。」 means…
差不多 = more or less the same.
Their level of Chinese is more or less the same.
A classmate notices that you study a lot and says:
You want to say “Because it was raining, we didn’t go”. Which sentence is correct?
因为 = cause, 所以 = consequence.
You are asked 「你是什么时候来中国的？」. Which answer is correct?
Someone compliments your Chinese. Answer modestly:
哪里哪里 = oh, not at all.
「只要每天读课文，就能记住生词。」 means…
As long as you read the text every day, you’ll memorise the new words.
If you don’t read every day you remember the words.
You only need to read the new words.
The new words are read every day.
Which sentence means “Class is about to start”?
Your phone is dead. How do you say it?
没电了 = the battery is dead.
You are asked 「你是坐火车来的吗？」 and you came by plane. What do you answer?
「你来的时候，我正在洗衣服呢。」 What was the speaker doing?
I thought (wrongly) you had gone back to your country.
I know you went back to your country.
I hope you go back to your country.
I want you to go back to your country.
Which sentence describes two actions at the same time?
You are asked 「你的宿舍离教室远吗？」 and it’s close. What do you answer?
How do you say “the two of us”?
A friend was supposed to leave, but you meet him in the dorm. You ask in surprise:
How is 得 read in 「我得走了。」?
You are asked 「旅行好玩儿吗？」 and it was wonderful. What do you answer?
The shop assistant asks 「您穿多大号的？」. What does she want to know?
A piece of clothing is too loose on you. What do you say?
Your size isn’t available and you give up. What do you say?
一 + MW + 比 + 一 + MW = progression.
Every lesson has the same words.
Only one lesson has more words.
Which sentence means “None of these clothes fit me”?
It’s cold outside. A friend advises you:
The shop assistant has shown you lots of styles. To thank her you say:
麻烦您了 = sorry for the trouble / thanks for your trouble.
You are asked 「你家有几口人？」. Which answer is correct?
You are asked 「你爸爸做什么工作？」 and your father is a lawyer. What do you answer?
You are asked 「你大学毕业了吗？」 and you graduate next year. What do you answer?
How do you say “She looks a lot like her mother”?
A classmate looks at a photo: 「哪个是你？」. You are the one at the back. What do you answer?
后边那个 = the one at the back.
Lunar New Year, the most important traditional festival
1 January, New Year in the solar calendar
Which sentence uses 或者 correctly?
或者 in statements; in questions you use 还是.
You want to wish everyone happy holidays. What do you say?
「我一到家就给你打电话。」 means…
As soon as I get home I’ll call you.
I’ll get home and call you some day.
I’ll call you before I get home.
You are asked 「你需要什么吗？」 and you don’t need anything. What do you answer?
A friend is very nervous before the exam. You say:
Let’s go and eat together, you and me!
